QF.id: AIFM CII Legal Documents and Negotiations_23

question.text: For how long must AIFs maintain investors' complaints data, and what is the maximum period after each quarter-end by which the data must be compiled?

answer.text: Last 1 financial year; compiled within 30 days of quarter end.
Last 5 financial years; compiled within 21 days from the end of each quarter.
Throughout the tenure of the fund; compiled within 30 days of financial year end only.
Last 3 financial years from the date of submission; compiled within 7 days from the end of each quarter.

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Chapter 8, AIFs must maintain investor complaints data for the last 3 financial years from the date of submission. Data is to be compiled WITHIN 7 DAYS from the end of each quarter (March, June, Sep, Dec) and disclosed to investors and SEBI. **The Trap:** 1-year / 30-day is too short; 5-year / 21-day and full-tenure retention are over-retention traps. The chapter is specific: 3 years + 7-day quarterly compilation. **Cross-Exam Context:** XIX-C tests the same retention. SCORES-level complaint handling adds a separate 30-day-response timeline — do not mix the 7-day compile with the 30-day redress. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Run an internal complaints dashboard rebuilt by T+5 after quarter end so you have a 2-day buffer to validate the data before T+7 public disclosure. Last-minute compilation is error-prone and visible to LPs.
